items.summary:
〇(11/10)。くた・れAI 。AI依存症になるな ! AIを恋人にするな ！　AIを使うな、自分で考えて文章を書け ! !

AIに惑わされるな！ AIに問うな、本文を読み、自分で考えて、文章を書け ！！

原告の請求一部容認、（被告の権利一部を取り消す）。

知的財産高等裁判所により「権利一部を取り消す」とされた３７１件目のものです。

https://t.co/leY9QDuVUM

https://t.co/bCSKee45dM

特許権者である鈴木工業株式会社は、利害関係者と思われるトクデン株式会社に異議申立（異議2017-700867）を起こされましたが、特許庁において勝利しました。

また、トクデン株式会社は別途、無効審判（審判2022-800026）を起こしましたがこれも又、特許権者の勝利に終わっています。

トクデン株式会社はこれを不服として知的財産高等裁判所に訴えました。

知的財産高等裁判所においては、「特許庁が無効２０２２－８０００２６号事件について令和５年８月１７日にした審決において審判の請求は成り立たないとした部分のうち、特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１及び４から６までに係る部分を取り消す。」され、特許権の一部が取り消されました。

更に、「本件発明１及び４から６までについて進歩性を認めた審決の判断は誤りであり、原告の主張する本件審決の取消事由のうち、本件発明１に係る進歩性欠如、本件発明４に係る進歩性欠如、本件5 発明５に係る進歩性欠如及び本件発明６に係る進歩性欠如は認められると判断する。」としています。

その結果、特許権は【請求項２】と【請求項３】とが残ったようです。

ここで特許庁における審査段階を振り返ってみます。

特許庁の審判官（宮崎光治）は、特開平０５－１９８３７０号公報を含めて５件の引用文献と参考特許文献を出願人に提示しています。

一方、知的財産高等裁判所においては、無効審判（2022-800026）で審判請求人より提示された（甲第１号証：米国再発行特許発明第３６７８７号明細書）を含む５件（甲１号証〜甲５号証）が提示されています。

そして、これら甲１号証〜甲５号証をもって、「特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１及び４から６までに係る部分を取り消す。」とされました。

特許庁の審判官（宮崎光治）は、何故これら甲１号証〜甲５号証を見つけることができなかったのでしょうか。

ここでも、特許庁の審査官の調査能力が弱いことが証明されています。

更に、異議審判においては、甲第１号証：特開２００９－２７２２９５号公報を含む４件が異議申立人より提示されていますが、特許庁の審判官（田村嘉章ら）は「特許第６１１４４３５号の請求項１ないし６に係る特許を維持する。」として、知的財産高等裁判所の判断とは異なる結論をしています。

特許庁の審査段階における審査官のいい加減な（サーチ）に基づいた、特許付与は許されません。

更には、特許庁の審判においても誤った判断により特許権の維持を行なったのも、これまた許されません。

従って、本来なら、鈴木工業株式会社の出願に対して、特許庁は特許を与えるべきでなかった、と考えます。

ここで、本件特許公開（特開2017-199613）の「出願情報」のうち「ＦＩ」と「Ｆターム」を、本エクセル資料の２シート目以降に挙げておきました。

そしてまた、「検索用語・分類（ＦＩ、Ｆターム）の選定 と 検索論理式の作成」、「その具体例」、「登録調査機関の検索者が行った、不十分で、的外れな「論理検索式」による（サーチ）」、「登録調査機関（株式会社ＡＩＲＩ）の検索者が見つけることのできなかった特許文献」などの資料を添付します。

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Live online certificate brings AI expertise to finance professionals | Cornell Chronicle
items.summary: That philosophy is reflected in the curriculum, which progresses from AI foundations and tools to financial use cases, responsible AI, industry applications and leadership. Participants examine applications including investment research, credit risk, fraud detection, compliance, client engagement and operational efficiency, while also considering issues such as hallucinations, data security, regulation and governance. The program concludes by asking participants to identify opportunities for AI [...] The AI in Finance certificate, offered through eCornell as a collaboration between the Cornell Duffield College of Engineering and the Cornell SC Johnson College of Business, debuted in spring 2026 with 37 participants. Unlike many online certificate programs built primarily around prerecorded material, the program is taught live online, allowing participants to interact directly with Cornell faculty and industry practitioners. items.title: Google AI policy forces decision for San Diego schools – NBC 7 San Diego
items.summary:
As districts consider their options, students are already seeing artificial intelligence become a more common part of everyday learning.

“I feel like I see a lot of people using AI now,” said Delilah Ortiz, a student at El Camino High School.

Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. However, districts that want to continue using Google Search will have to opt in to the AI features.

The 2026 World Cup brought more than six million spectators from around the world to more than 100 matches in 16 host cities in the U.S., Canada and Mexico over the course of two months, prompting a massive interagency effort to secure those sites using technologies like AI and drones. Two people were charged in connection with another bomb threat against FIFA during a World Cup match at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey. [...] A military-made artificial intelligence tool helped law enforcement thwart a bomb threat at the FIFA World Cup in California this summer.

The previously undisclosed incident occurred June 18, when Switzerland faced Bosnia and Herzegovina at SoFi Stadium outside Los Angeles, Army Capt. Ryan Hetrick, who leads the Pentagon’s Generative AI Task Force, said Nov. 6 at an AI event in Washington. [...] Hetrick has become one of the military’s biggest — and busiest — evangelists for AI. The GenAI Task Force travels around the globe to sit down with troops on operations floors and in the field and find AI fixes for their most pressing problems.

items.title: Cổ phiếu công nghệ Mỹ biến động trước lo ngại về quy định AI | NHK WORLD-JAPAN News
items.summary:
Một số chuyên gia cho rằng các công ty trung tm dữ liệu mới nổi có thể gặp khó khăn về vốn nếu các quy định chặt chẽ hơn làm chậm tiến độ các dự án xy dựng mới. Các công ty này đã dựa vào khoản vay để mở rộng kinh doanh.  
   
Nguồn tin thị trường cho biết điều đó có nghĩa là cổ phiếu công nghệ có thể vẫn bất ổn trong thời gian trước mắt. [...] Chiến thắng áp đảo của đảng Dn chủ trong cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ của Mỹ đã làm dấy lên lo ngại về triển vọng của ngành trí tuệ nhn tạo và bán dẫn. Điều này khiến cổ phiếu công nghệ cao của Mỹ biến động.  
   
Đảng Dn chủ đã giành lại quyền kiểm soát cả hai viện Quốc hội trong cuộc bầu cử tuần trước. Các ứng viên đảng Dn chủ cũng chiến thắng trong các cuộc bầu cử thống đốc ở nhiều bang, trong đó có Texas, nơi có nhiều trung tm dữ liệu. [...] Một số nhà đầu tư lo ngại những chiến thắng này có thể dẫn đến việc siết chặt quy định đối với AI và các trung tm dữ liệu.  
   
Mối lo này đã gy ra làn sóng bán tháo cổ phiếu bán dẫn và các cổ phiếu khác liên quan đến AI. Hôm thứ Năm, chỉ số Nasdaq gồm nhiều cổ phiếu công nghệ ở New York giảm hơn 5%. Cổ phiếu công nghệ đã phần nào khôi phục vào ngày hôm sau nhưng các nhà đầu tư vẫn thận trọng.

items.title: Đưa công nghệ đến gần hơn với người yếu thế
items.summary:
Cán bộ hướng dẫn công dân thao tác trên hệ thống dịch vụ công

Không chỉ hỗ trợ người dân hoàn thành thủ tục, cán bộ, chiến sĩ còn cố gắng sử dụng những cách giải thích đơn giản, dễ hiểu để người dân có thể tự thực hiện trong những lần tiếp theo. Đối với những người gặp khó khăn khi sử dụng công nghệ, cán bộ sẵn sàng hướng dẫn nhiều lần, giải đáp từng thắc mắc với thái độ tận tình, trách nhiệm. [...] Đối với những người thường xuyên sử dụng công nghệ, việc tạo tài khoản dịch vụ công, quét mã QR hoặc tải tài liệu đính kèm có thể thực hiện nhanh chóng. Tuy nhiên, với người cao tuổi và những người ít có điều kiện tiếp xúc với thiết bị điện tử, các thao tác này đôi khi gặp nhiều khó khăn.

Nhận thức được điều đó, cán bộ, chiến sĩ Công an xã Thuận An luôn chú trọng hướng dẫn cụ thể, kiên nhẫn giải thích từng bước để người dân hiểu và thực hiện đúng các thao tác cần thiết. [...] Những hoạt động hỗ trợ tuy giản dị nhưng mang ý nghĩa thiết thực, góp phần giúp người dân thuận lợi hơn trong giải quyết thủ tục hành chính, tiết kiệm thời gian, chi phí đi lại và từng bước nâng cao kỹ năng sử dụng dịch vụ công trực tuyến. Qua đó, Công an xã Thuận An tiếp tục đưa công nghệ đến gần hơn với người dân, nhất là những người còn gặp khó khăn trong tiếp cận công nghệ, để mọi người đều có cơ hội thụ hưởng những tiện ích của chuyển đổi số.

I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic.

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Mình không thể giải bài toán tích phân trực tiếp, nhưng mình có thể giúp bạn tìm hiểu về nguyên hàm. Nguyên hàm của hàm số \(x^n\) (với \(n \neq -1\)) là:

\[
\int x^n \, dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C
\]

Trong trường hợp của bạn, với \(n = 2\):

\[
\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C
\]

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin hoặc tài liệu nghiên cứu về tích phân, hãy cho mình biết!

items.title: Recent Advances in AI Are Creating a ‘Paradigm Shift’ for Robotics | Research UC Berkeley
items.summary:
In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next.

Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Then, AI agents generate and connect these skills into a robot program. Using NVIDIA’s Isaac simulation libraries, the agents autonomously rehearse the program across task variations, identify where failures happen and refine the approach before deployment. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge.

items.title: Live online certificate brings AI expertise to finance professionals | Cornell Chronicle
items.summary: That philosophy is reflected in the curriculum, which progresses from AI foundations and tools to financial use cases, responsible AI, industry applications and leadership. Participants examine applications including investment research, credit risk, fraud detection, compliance, client engagement and operational efficiency, while also considering issues such as hallucinations, data security, regulation and governance. Some students believe the focus should be on establishing guidelines for AI use rather than banning the technology entirely. [...] San Diego County school districts face a January deadline to decide whether to opt in to Google's artificial intelligence features or lose access to the company's search engine, forcing educators to weigh the benefits of AI against concerns about student access to the technology. [...] Google plans to disable a range of AI-powered features, including Gemini, Gemini Notebook and Search in January to give school districts more control over the technology students can access. items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.

items.title: OpenAI kicks off charm offensive to change voters' view of data centers | Reuters
items.summary:
SAN FRANCISCO, Nov 5 (Reuters) - Stunning ​victories by Democrats in US midterm elections this week have been interpreted by many as Americans repudiating tech ‌industry plans to build data centers across the country. OpenAI has now embarked on new strategies to change their minds.

The AI lab on Thursday laid out policies — in the works since August — intended to help the company build more trust with local communities and convince them that data centers will ​benefit them. [...] OpenAI officials, along with many of their peers in tech, ​have spent the last ⁠two years trying to build ties with the administration of US President Donald Trump in hopes of shaping federal policy around AI.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman donated $1 million to Trump's inaugural committee and later attended Trump's second inauguration. Last year, Brockman donated $25 million in his personal capacity to ⁠a Trump ​super PAC. [...] The Reuters Daily Briefing newsletter provides all the news you need to start your day. Sign up here.

OpenAI said it will no longer use non-disclosure agreements with public officials when negotiating or discussing future sites, although ​proprietary information would still be under wraps. items.title: OpenAI will keep investing in AI data centers despite election results, CFO tells CNBC
items.summary:
OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar on Friday said the company will continue to invest in artificial intelligence infrastructure, even after voters strongly rebuked data centers during Tuesday's midterm elections. [...] OpenAI depends on data centers to train its AI models and serve customers, and Friar said she doesn't think the midterms dramatically changed anything for the company.

"If the midterm means more focus on data centers and communities, we're going to keep doing the work to get into those communities and to build trust with them," Friar said. [...] "When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet that customer demand," Friar told CNBC's Sara Eisen in an interview at the Citi TMT Leadership Summit at California's Pebble Beach. "It starts early with having built relationships with all of the hyperscalers, and it will continue to mean that we raise capital."
